Game Overview

Escape Dark Castle is a platformer title where guide Zenith through a haunting castle teeming with devious traps and mind-bending puzzles. With escalating intensity, this game challenges your agility and problem-solving prowess. Embrace the thrill of mastering each level's unique perils, delivering an exhilarating and cerebral adventure into the castle's shadowy depths.
